title: Effect of freeze-drying and oven-drying on the physicochemical and morphological properties of marjoram essential oil beads produced by ionic gelation
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,2709-2719
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00857C, Paper
Open Access

Karen Elbert Leal Mazza, André Mesquita Magalhães Costa, Humberto Ribeiro Bizzo, Renata Valeriano Tonon
This study explored the impact of different drying methods – freeze-drying (FD) and oven-drying (OD) – on the physicochemical properties of marjoram essential oil (MEO) beads produced by ionic gelation.
